If you sell digital products, these are 3 legal documents you need to know about, and most sellers completely overlook number 3 👀 1️⃣ Digital Product Purchase Agreement This can establish the terms of the purchase, including restrictions on sharing or reselling your digital product and other important purchase terms. 2️⃣ Website/Store Terms & Conditions Your Terms & Conditions establish the rules for your online business and can address things like refunds, intellectual property, and limitations of liability. 3️⃣ Content Usage License If a brand or client pays to use your videos, templates, graphics, courses, or other content, a content usage license can clearly define how they can use it, where, for how long, and what happens if they go beyond those rights. Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. 💅🏾 And no, you don't necessarily need to spend hundreds on legal fees just to get foundational documents in place. If your digital products are getting attention but buyers still hesitate, the problem may not be the product—it may be how the VALUE is packaged. 👀 While creating this exclusive Pink Halloween Coloring Book for my Halloween Kids Activities Bundle, here’s the marketing psychology I’d like to share: Selling products individually makes customers evaluate each purchase separately. A well-positioned digital product bundle can change that comparison: 🎃 More products in one purchase 💰 Easier-to-see overall value 🧩 A more complete solution for one specific need ✨ An exclusive bonus they can’t purchase separately Instead of making the customer think: “Which activity should I buy?” I want the offer to communicate: “Everything I need is already here.” That’s where perceived value + reduced decision fatigue + exclusivity can strengthen an offer. And as digital-product creators, we don’t always need to start from zero. You can strategically combine products you already created, organize them around one customer situation, and add an exclusive product that makes the bundle feel fresh and complete. Before creating your next bundle, ask: Who is this for? What situation are they trying to solve? What would make this feel complete? What exclusive bonus would make the bundle more compelling? Don’t bundle random files just to increase the quantity. Bundle the solution. ✨ 📌 Save this for your next digital-product launch. #DigitalProductMarketing #SellDigitalProducts #DigitalProductCreator #CanvaBusiness #herrycreates
